nuggets.text: The Bison won their first-ever FBS game, beating Jacksonville State 33-7 on Aug. 29.
The Bison are 2-0 in their first FBS season after a 38-0 shutout of Fordham.
The Bison defense has allowed just 7.0 points per game, ranked first nationally so far.
The Bison left the FCS and joined the Mountain West for football on July 1, 2026.
The Bison won 10 FCS national championships between 2011 and 2024.
The Bison hold the FCS record for the longest winning streak: 39 straight games from 2017 to 2021.
Tim Polasek won the FCS national title in his first year as Bison head coach, beating Montana State 35-32.
Tim Polasek already knows the Mountain West: he became Wyoming's offensive coordinator in 2021.
The Fargodome was planned with an inflatable roof; it got a fixed hard roof, but the dome name stuck.
Two Bison quarterbacks went in the top three of the NFL Draft: Carson Wentz (2nd, 2016) and Trey Lance (3rd, 2021).
